title: Cái này có nước mắm không?
pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong
summary: For checking fish sauce in a dish, dipping sauce, dressing, or marinade before you eat.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before ordering, dipping, or accepting a sauce if fish sauce is a dietary issue for you.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the dish, sauce cup, or menu photo. Pause for a yes or no before explaining allergies.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Cái này means this one; có nước mắm means has fish sauce; không? makes it yes/no.

breakdown.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good with dipping sauces, soups, marinades, salads, and rice dishes where fish sauce may not be obvious.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Fish sauce is common in Vietnamese cooking, including dressings and dipping sauces. If it is an allergy, say the allergy phrase too.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Peanut, egg, vegetarian, and allergy phrases help with nearby dietary checks.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: No-meat, ingredient-removal, safest-dish, meat-identification, and shrimp checks cover the same menu decision from different angles.
